label: Composer (detail cut)
description: The DETAIL CUT: just an input box isolated huge on the canvas -- no window chrome, no sidebar. Types a prompt char-by-char (scrub-safe) and presses send. Use when the story beat is 'the ask', cropped to the one element that matters instead of a whole app window. Size it wide and shallow (e.g. w 46%, h 22%).

at.label: When typing starts (default 0.5; card rises 0.4s earlier)

send_at.label: When the send button presses (default: 0.5s after typing ends). Pass null to never send.

clear_on_send.label: Clear the field right after send

accent.label: Send-button / caret color (default warm terracotta #c2612e; set brand primary for Quotient beats)

exit_at.label: Fade the whole block at this second

pretyped.label: Prefix already standing at frame one (string or count); typing continues from there. The era chain carries one sentence -- a match-cut into this card must not restart it.
